facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet laid out in three sections: a large hero panel at top, a middle row of three full-body turnaround views, and a bottom row of four detail close-ups.
The top panel shows a person standing on a wet, reflective rooftop or balcony at night in rain, with metal railings on both sides and blurred city lights and a warm-lit building in the background.
The person has short, closely shaved sides with longer hair gathered into a small topknot, and a diagonal scar is visible on the cheek in the face close-up.
The person wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with a front zipper and shoulder strap with metal buckle, a black undershirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the top hero panel, the person stands with feet apart, arms relaxed at the sides, and head turned toward the viewer's left.
The label "HERO" appears centered beneath the large top panel.
The middle row contains three full-body views of the same person against a dark neutral backdrop, labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "BACK".
In the front, side profile, and back panels, the person stands upright with arms relaxed at the sides.
The bottom row contains four close-up panels labeled "FACE", "JACKET COLLAR", "HANDS", and "BOOTS".
The face close-up shows a neutral expression, direct gaze, shaved sides, pulled-back hair, and a visible cheek scar.
The jacket-collar close-up shows the black fabric, zipper, and a strap with a metal buckle.
The hands close-up shows weathered hands with visible veins, knuckles, and grime; the boots close-up shows worn black lace-up combat boots.
